lastChange.note: Design system 2.15: thirteen gaps decided. GAP-169 (the owner's): the guest nav becomes a pill track so both destinations carry ink, and it stays links with aria-current, never aria-pressed. The --border question answered once and system-wide: border is a divider, border-strong is any boundary that carries meaning; .pp-seg's track and .pp-modelbtn's resting edge move, .pp-tabs' rail deliberately does not. GAP-168: .pp-lift takes min-width 0. GAP-167: ScreenQueue's 2.12 section restored verbatim. GAP-166: role User sees no tags. New: GAP-170 (the visitor's payment is a header line), GAP-171 rejected (no search field), GAP-172 (the guest head is one height at every studio name), GAP-176, GAP-177, GAP-178; GAP-173/174/175 numbered and left to the owner. No token, class or copy key removed or renamed; one new class, .pp-guestexit.
